g.text: Welfare = (consumption − 0.5 × shortfall) / (members × ticks); infrastructure has no direct welfare bonus.

g.text: Private utility = (consumption + 0.2 × terminal wealth) / episode length. Arrows mark preferred direction.

g.text: Exploratory pilot: fresh cases describe these populations; they are not independent evolutionary runs.
